summary: vmware.vmware_rest disables turbo mode by default for module execution. It can be enabled through an environment variable.
questions: Why are vmware_rest modules slower after upgrading?
Is turbo mode enabled by default in vmware_rest?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest turbo mode off by default
answer_card.answer_md: vmware.vmware_rest no longer uses turbo mode by default. You can opt in with an environment variable (see the collection docs).
